name: infix-postfix-converter
description: Interactive Infix-to-Postfix Expression Converter and Evaluator - Compiler Construction project

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "magenta,cyan" "npm run start --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace client && npm run test --workspace server
